parameters.name: CheckType
parameters.description:
The data validation method. Valid values:

- **1**: full data validation.
- **2**: incremental data validation.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization task. You can call the [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) operation to query the task ID.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page.

parameters.name: SchemaName
parameters.description: The schema name of the object to be verified in the source database.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the verification result. Valid values:
- **-1** (default): all statuses.
- **6**: tables with inconsistent data.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The name of the table to be verified in the source database.
